52534.author: makortel
52534.body:
#### PR description:

This PR is (the last) part of the series of backports of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911 following the request in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/47050#issuecomment-6069544996. In contrast to the earlier series of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52369 and its forward-ports, or the 16_0_X backport https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52458, this PR backports only #50911.

There were some conflicts in `FWStorage/Catalog/test/InputFileCatalog_t.cpp` because in 17_0_X the https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51235 was done after #50911, but in 16_1_X the https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51236 was include before this PR.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911
